oss.title: Show HN: Thaw – Git branch for a running LLM (fork agents, skip prefill)
oss.summary: I built thaw because forking an LLM agent is absurdly wasteful today. When an agent explores N branches — RL rollouts, best-of-N, parallel coding attempts — each branch re-runs prefill over the same shared context. You pay for the same prompt N times.thaw snapshots a live inference session — weight
